# John Eduard De Villa — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio of John Eduard De Villa, a full-stack developer in Nasugbu,
> Batangas, Philippines. 4th-year BSIT (Business Analytics) student shipping
> production systems for real clients — 7 systems shipped for 5 clients.

## What I build

- HILOM EHR: electronic health records, live pilot for a Nasugbu medical
  center (28+ tables, JWT auth, AES-256-GCM field-level encryption).
- LayRate: offline poultry-farm egg-production monitoring on Raspberry Pi 5 +
  Arduino (capstone, SARIMA/XGBoost forecasting in development).
- Talent Scout AI: job-matching platform for the Nasugbu job market.
- HairConnect: AI hairstyle recommendations + barbershop/salon ratings.
- J&R Photography Studio: booking & scheduling system (live client).
- Plant Selling & Management System: Java desktop POS & inventory.
- Library, Grading & Gym Management Systems: commissioned C# desktop apps.
- Student Portal: grade management with JasperReports academic documents.

## Stack

React, React Native (Expo), Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, CodeIgniter, MySQL,
MariaDB, SQLite, Docker, Railway, Vercel, Power BI, Tableau.
